description: CF-CONFECTIONERY sold 548.5K fewer units (12.4%), from 4.42M to 3.87M versus the prior period, representing about 176.5% of the total decline in unit sales. The decline was concentrated in chocolate, especially chocolate coated bars, within CF-CONFECTIONERY.

insight.title: Chocolate units decline
insight.summary: Most of the shortfall sat within CF-CHOCOLATE and was heavily concentrated in chocolate coated bars. This suggests the category decline was driven by a narrow part of the range rather than evenly across confectionery.
insight.action: Review CF-CONFECTIONERY chocolate and chocolate coated bars performance by SKU, availability, and promotional activity.

description: CFH021 revenue increased by 4.18M (11.4%), from 36.76M to 40.94M versus the prior period, representing about 138.3% of the total increase in revenue. The increase was supported more by higher average revenue per item than by selling more units, with added support from more transactions.

insight.title: CFH021 growth driver
insight.summary: The gain was concentrated in GM FASHION and FASHION within CFH021. This suggests the branch improvement was associated with stronger selling in those areas and a higher average revenue per item.
insight.action: Examine CFH021 GM FASHION and FASHION to compare item sales, average revenue per item, and transaction patterns.

description: month=4 revenue increased by 2.11M (14.0%), from 15.09M to 17.20M versus the prior period, representing about 69.8% of the total increase in revenue. This month accounted for a large part of the total uplift in revenue.

insight.title: April revenue uplift
insight.summary: The increase was concentrated in April's contribution to the overall revenue change. This may reflect a period-specific trading effect, so the result should be read alongside adjacent months.
insight.action: Compare April against the months before and after to confirm which business areas were most associated with the uplift.

description: CFH017 revenue decreased by 1.31M (5.9%), from 22.22M to 20.91M versus the prior period, representing an offset equal to about 43.3% of the total increase in revenue. The decline was linked mainly to selling fewer units, with fewer transactions also weighing on the result.

insight.title: CFH017 revenue drag
insight.summary: The weakness was associated with FMCG FOOD and CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES in CFH017. Our checks suggest the branch decline was concentrated in those areas rather than spread evenly across the branch.
insight.action: Investigate CFH017 FMCG FOOD and CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES to compare item sales and transaction trends against the prior period.
